_format.name: speaking_part3_sets
_format.description: Speaking Part 3 discussion set: 4-5 abstract questions on a theme, usually linked to a Part 2 cue card.
_format.currentSourceInApp: speaking.cueCards[].part3 (the app builds Part 3 from the linked cue card today)
relations: cueCardId → speaking_cue_cards.id (optional; empty = standalone Part 3 practice)
notes: Exported from the cue cards, one set per card. New Part 3 sets can be written without a cue card.

practiceParts.label: Speaking Part 3 (discussion)
practiceParts.format: Examiner asks deeper follow-up questions on the Part 2 theme

items.theme: Describe a person who taught you something useful
questions: What qualities make a good teacher?
Do people learn more from family or from school?
Is it better to learn practical skills from a person or from online videos?
Should older people keep learning new skills?
How has the role of teachers changed in recent years?

items.theme: Describe a quiet place you like to visit
questions: Why do people need quiet places in cities?
Is noise pollution getting worse in your country?
Should there be more rules about noise in public places?
Do young people enjoy silence as much as older people?
